lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Crystal Cavern HR. All hiring for the entire kingdom happens here. The paperwork is beautiful AND sharp.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Why are we here?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Someone classified you as "contractor". We're getting you benefits, hero. Even if we have to fight the dental plan. ESPECIALLY the dental plan.

lines.speaker: Benefits Basilisk
lines.text: Sssso. You wish to enroll. Have you read the plan documentsss?

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Nobody reads the plan documents.

lines.speaker: Benefits Basilisk
lines.text: CORRECT. Those who read... are STONE. You may yet ssssurvive. Open enrollment... hasss begun.
The corner office. It has no corners. It is a geode the size of a house, wearing a blazer.

lines.speaker: VP of Vibes
lines.text: Heyyy, team! Love the energy. Love it. Quick vibe check before I approve your paperwork?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Our vibes are excellent and fully documented!

lines.speaker: VP of Vibes
lines.text: Mmm. See, I'm getting more of a "hostile takeover" energy? Which, respect. Let's workshop it. WITH VIOLENCE.

lines.speaker: VP of Vibes
lines.text: Okay... wow... big feelings today... approving... everything...

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Full benefits! Retroactive! Hero, you have DENTAL. You can't be stopped now.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Onward. I want to use this dental plan on something.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Mandatory Fun Cavern. The pizza party is in forty minutes. Attendance is being TRACKED, hero.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: We could just... attend? Eat pizza? Rest?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The pizza is a crystal. The party is a performance review. The fun is MANDATORY. Weapons out.
The wall of the cavern is a diagram. The diagram is looking at you.

lines.speaker: The Org Chart
lines.text: WHERE... DO YOU... REPORT?

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Nowhere. We're independent.

lines.speaker: The Org Chart
lines.text: UNACCEPTABLE. EVERYONE IS A BOX. YOU WILL BE A BOX. THE DEPARTMENT OF DOOM REQUIRES IT.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: There's that name again, hero. They're EVERYWHERE.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: I can't believe Ranger Doreen was moonlighting as HR security. I can't believe she whistled at us AGAIN.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: She said the benefits here are excellent.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: They ARE. That's the horrifying part. Now — the corner office. Match the vibes. BEAT the vibes.
